author: Hermes
question: A 6.6 kV feeder is studied on a voltage base of 11 kV. What is the feeder voltage in per unit?
solution: Vpu = actual/base = 6.6/11 = 0.6 pu. Topic (per-unit representation) is in the Power Systems section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Power Systems
